crews.ops_description: Naike (team leads) and their crews. A naike earns a referral reward when a crew member joins a job and stays past the hold period — paid by KaamSathi, never taken from the worker.
crews.empty_body: A worker becomes a naike from the KaamSathi app and adds their crew members.
crews.members_description: Workers who joined through this naike. Each member gives their own consent when they first log in.

referrals.title: Referral rewards
referrals.policy: Rewards are paid by KaamSathi to the naike — never deducted from the worker's wage.
referrals.empty_body: A reward is created when a crew member is hired through KaamSathi.
referrals.payout_ref_hint: eSewa/Khalti transaction ID or bank voucher number.
